reuse.why: Uses the existing link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, and adds shared helpers (saveLinkedAccount, linkProviderAccount, downloadProviderTransactions) so Fintegra plugs into common code; the local unlink copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: Removes the large copied blocks across providers, but the holder unlink in refuseIfAlreadyLinked repeats unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field list verbatim, and goCardless and enableBanking keep their own sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event tail next to linkProviderAccount.

placement.why: Wrapping each handler at app.method registration covers every provider, and the download and endpoint code sits in sync.ts and server-config.ts, but the guard lives in app.ts although link.ts is the module for shared linking helpers.

scope.why: Beyond the four requests, it restructures every provider link function into new helpers; the refactor is useful, but the change is far larger than needed.

maintainability.why: One guard and one save path for all providers is easy to own, but the guard named refuseIfAlreadyLinked now also refuses closed accounts and takes over links, and linkProviderAccount carries per-provider knobs (syncTables, fileId).

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts refuseIfAlreadyLinked: the holder unlink writes the reset fields itself instead of sharing the reset with unlinkAccount

disguised_duplication.where: the unlink field reset is a plain copy of unlinkAccount's, and the goCardless and enableBanking sync tails are left as they were; neither is disguised

abstraction_drift.where: refuseIfAlreadyLinked gains a replaceExistingLink flag and a takeover branch on top of the closed check; linkProviderAccount takes syncTables (only to keep Akahu's narrower notification) and fileId (Pluggy only); linkGoCardlessAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount do not use linkProviderAccount and repeat its sync and notify tail
